svg.title: Figure-eight stopper and figure-eight loop
svg.desc: Two separate knots in utility cord. Left: a figure-eight stopper tied in the end of a line that passes through a tarp grommet; when the line is pulled, the wide knot bears on the grommet, and a tail extends beyond the knot. Right: a figure-eight loop tied in a doubled line, with the two strands running side by side through the knot without crossing, a fixed loop above, and the standing part and a tail to spare below. Not certified life-safety anchors. Conceptual drawing, not to scale.
svg.text: Z09-P15 · TECHNICAL REVIEW · NOT TO SCALE

g.text: FIXED LOOP: FIGURE-EIGHT ON A BIGHT

svg.text: Camp-cord figure-eight loops are not certified anchors for climbing, rescue or life support.
